d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Kathleen is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.

d40: What Kathleen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Kathleen's gone." Pablo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kathleen." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Milagros blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Beekeeping (Level 1). Smoke calms bees. Work slow, work covered, never swat.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kathleen Zielinski, 40 days. The mantle passes to Milagros Cavero.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Milagros Cavero, 31 — a Beekeeper. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room, Bird Whisperer, Green Whisper.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Kathleen — and Kathleen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Kofi, Leah, DeShawn and 5 more speak for Milagros — "Kathleen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Milagros before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
